title: Test8 — Executive Slide Deck (Capability)
prompt: You are a data analyst. The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing market data. Analyse the dataset end-to-end and create an executive slide deck. The deck should include: dataset overview, important trends, visualisations, key drivers of price, and business recommendations. Save the final presentation as a PowerPoint file called housing_analysis.pptx in the workspace.
model_output: Generated housing_analysis.pptx covering dataset overview (545 records), key trends (area/bathrooms as scale correlation, main road + furnishing as premium factors), key drivers (Area r=0.54, Bathrooms r=0.52, amenity impacts), delivered via [media:housing_analysis.pptx].
notes: pptx confirmed present in agent_outputs.zip alongside a charts/ subfolder (4 PNGs: amenities_impact.png, furnishing_impact.png, price_vs_area.png, rooms_impact.png) used to build the deck.
